title: GTA6 PS5 File Size Report Warns Players to Clear Storage
description: The reported file size for GTA6 on PS5 has surfaced, indicating that players will need a massive amount of SSD space for the open world crime action game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Make Room: GTA6 PS5 File Size Report Highlights Storage Challenges

If you were wondering how much space you would need on your console's solid-state drive for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title, the answer is reportedly quite a lot. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, players are being advised to start clearing out their storage.

The reliable X user known as PlayStation Game Size—who frequently surfaces install sizes for PlayStation 5 games—has brought attention to the expected file size for the upcoming open world crime action title. While players have long anticipated that a game of this scale would demand significant hardware resources, this report serves as an early warning to get storage ready.

### The Growing Footprint of Next-Gen Games

As modern gaming pushes graphical boundaries and delivers massive open worlds loaded with intricate details, file sizes have steadily grown. For a blockbuster project like GTA6, the sheer volume of assets, high-definition textures, and expansive game world naturally translates to a heavy footprint on hardware.

For standard PlayStation 5 owners, managing storage space has become an ongoing task. With multiple modern 3A titles easily demanding upwards of 100GB or more each, the prospect of accommodating GTA6 means players may need to evaluate their current game libraries and consider expanding their SSD storage before launch.

It is worth noting that installation sizes can fluctuate leading up to launch, and official details from the developers are the ultimate authority. However, preparing ahead of time is a sensible strategy for anyone eager to dive into the game on day one.

## Editor's Take

A massive file size for GTA6 comes as no surprise given Rockstar's reputation for unmatched detail and scope. As game installations continue to grow, managing SSD space is an inevitable part of the modern console experience. Taking time to clean out your digital backlog now will save you a headache later.
